candidates.category: 18. Transport operators

candidates.name: C01 Taxi station and operator electronic trip register and audit pack
candidates.trigger: Act 23/2026 amending Act 120/2022, in force 1 June 2026: electronic register with taximeter serial numbers and satellite data, recording of fixed-price trip payments, 60-day retention, annual independent audit of electronic systems, licence revocation for repeated breaches
candidates.unchecked: Number of stations and operators; which dispatch/taximeter systems already meet the new register rules; whether the audit body is approved yet. Competitor search ('leigubílastöð hugbúnaður skráning ferða') not run for lack of budget.

candidates.buyer: Private vet practices and livestock owners (sheep, dairy, poultry, fish)
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.evidence: https://island.is/reglugerdir/nr/0303-2023 ; https://www.mast.is/static/files/kynningar/reglugerdrafraenskraningdyralyfja.pdf ; https://www.althingi.is/altext/156/s/0881.html (2025 answer says MAST did not say whether the data are held electronically; Heilsa being reprogrammed per bill notes)

candidates.name: C02 Antimicrobial and medicine-use reporting for vets and livestock keepers
candidates.trigger: Reg. 303/2023 art. 4 (EU 2021/578, 2022/209): vets, owners and keepers collect antimicrobial-use data by species and submit to MAST; reg. 303/2012: diagnoses and treatments logged in Heilsa within 3 days; Act 14/2022 on veterinary medicines
candidates.unchecked: Whether Heilsa has been rebuilt and has an API; vet practice management systems in use; vet count (small).

candidates.buyer: Small jewellers, gold/precious-stone sellers, art galleries and auction houses; also bookkeepers and tax advisers on the same list
candidates.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
candidates.existing: Not searched. Generic AML tools exist but are probably aimed at larger firms.
candidates.name: C03 AML registration and compliance pack for jewellers, precious-metal and art dealers
candidates.trigger: Act 140/2018 art. 36: registration with Skatturinn, risk assessment, due diligence on payments of EUR 10,000 or more, compliance officer, sanctions-list checks, annual Skatturinn survey (non-responders rated higher risk). Skatturinn registration notice dated 22 Dec 2025
candidates.unchecked: The 22 Dec 2025 notice gave no deadline or penalty; number of registered jewellers/art dealers; local AML packs. Competitor search ('peningaþvætti hugbúnaður áreiðanleikakönnun skartgripasalar') not run for lack of budget. Risk: close to a generic AML tool.

candidates.buyer: Staff-leasing firms, foreign service providers and the Icelandic user firms that hire them

candidates.existing: Not searched.
candidates.name: C04 Staff-leasing and foreign service-provider notifications, now at Vinnueftirlit
candidates.trigger: Act 139/2005: register, notice 8 working days before service when over 10 working days in 12 months, with staff list, addresses, nationality, work rights; since 1 Jan 2025 handled by Vinnueftirlit ríkisins
candidates.unchecked: Notification channel and volumes at Vinnueftirlit; whether a free state form exists.

candidates.buyer: Small charities and associations collecting or distributing funds across borders
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies
candidates.existing: Not searched. Registry is a state service.

candidates.trigger: Act 119/2019 (amended 110/2021): mandatory register at Ríkisskattstjóri; accounts within 6 months of year end, published within one month of approval; removal from register if inactive
candidates.unchecked: Number of registered associations; filing method; whether the cross-border limit makes the population tiny.

candidates.existing: Not searched; lift service firms probably handle this themselves.

candidates.trigger: Lift reg. candidates.unchecked: Lift count; who in practice tracks the duty; housing-association management software already covering it. Competitor search ('húsfélag hugbúnaður lyfta þjónustusamningur') not run for lack of budget.

candidates.buyer: Rural municipalities, health committees and licensed emptying contractors

candidates.trigger: Act 7/1998, regs 796/1999 and 799/1999: municipality keeps a register of treatment units; emptying on cycles (3 years in Húsavík), call-out fees when tanks are not ready
candidates.unchecked: Buyer is mainly municipalities; contractors few. Probably government-side.

candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.existing: Not searched.

candidates.trigger: Vinnueftirlit registers and periodically inspects boilers and pressure equipment; owners pay registration and inspection fees (2021 fee schedule)
candidates.unchecked: Inspection intervals and equipment counts.

candidates.trigger: Act 38/2013: record in state database Bústofn; autumn report by 20 Nov; MAST inspections at keeper's cost
candidates.unchecked: Third-party farm record software; whether farmers want help beyond the state system.

candidates.trigger: Act 64/1994: guide permit from Umhverfisstofnun, hunting reports, first-aid and shooting test renewals
candidates.unchecked: Number of guides (likely under 100); sources dated 2008-2011.

candidates.trigger: Permits under Act 7/1998 and reg. 303/2008 (dismantlers), reg. 846/2023 (small sheep abattoirs), health-committee licences (tattoo), Act 36/1993 (funeral), Act 140/2018 (exchange). No recurring report that software would clearly help.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: One search: only general withholding (staðgreiðsla) pages from Skatturinn, nothing specific to private households as employers; no household-employer register or special filing found. Low likelihood in a medium market. Not verified further.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Scrap processing needs a Umhverfisstofnun operating permit under Act 7/1998 and reg. 550/2018 (https://ust.is/library/Skrar/Atvinnulif/Starfsleyfi/Starfsleyfi-i-gildi/Verksmidjur/Starfsleyfi GMR.pdf). No scrap-dealer register, no per-transaction ID/record duty and no police reporting found. Few operators; nothing new.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No second-hand dealer or pawnbroker register found. Skatturinn's AML registration page lists precious-metal/stone dealers and art dealers but not second-hand dealers or pawnbrokers (https://island.is/s/skatturinn/frett/skraning-vegna-adgerda-gegn-peningathvaetti-og-fjarmognun-hrydjuverka-22-12-2025). Nothing new.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Jewellers and gold dealers are AML reporting entities supervised by Skatturinn (Act 140/2018 art. 36, EUR 10,000 cash threshold); registration via Skatturinn portal, annual survey (https://www.skatturinn.is/fagadilar/peningathvaetti/tilkynningarskyldir-adilar/skyldur-tilkynningarskyldra-adila). See candidate C03.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Reception stations need Umhverfisstofnun permit; parts dealers and collection sites need local health-committee permit (https://files.reglugerd.is/pdf/0303-2008/current). Scrapping fee (skilagjald) is claimed by the owner through island.is/skilavottord, so the state portal covers the payout flow (https://island.is/skilavottord). Few operators; weak.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Livestock keepers must record in the state database Bústofn and file the autumn report (haustskýrsla) by 20 Nov under Act 38/2013 (https://www.althingi.is/lagas/149b/2013038.html). State-run database. No livestock market or animal-transport register search done (animal transport not reached).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Reg. 846/2023 covers slaughter and cutting in small sheep and goat slaughterhouses, in force since 11 Aug 2023 (https://files.reglugerd.is/pdf/0846-2023/current). A ministry draft on small food businesses exists but adoption unconfirmed. Very few sites; nothing strong.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No beekeeper register or reporting duty found in the search; hobby-scale. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Vets must log diagnoses and prescription treatments in MAST's Heilsa database (reg. 303/2012, bufjarheilsa.is) within 3 days, same day if withdrawal period applies (https://www.mast.is/static/files/kynningar/reglugerdrafraenskraningdyralyfja.pdf). Reg. 303/2023 requires vets, owners and keepers to collect antimicrobial-use data and submit it to MAST by species (https://island.is/reglugerdir/nr/0303-2023); sales data go to Lyfjastofnun. Veterinary medicines Act 14/2022. See candidate C02.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: No search on well drillers or abstraction licences; budget used on other categories.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Septic tank (rotþró) emptying is run by municipalities or licensed contractors under health-committee permits; municipality keeps a register of treatment units (Act 7/1998, regs 796/1999 and 799/1999) (https://island.is/stjornartidindi/nr/0e81a4ee-e15d-4699-b12b-4e1fa02e4aa1). Local tariffs and rules, no national contractor register. See candidate C07.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Vinnueftirlitið registers and inspects boilers, pressure vessels and lifts; lifts need a service agreement with an installer, use is banned before a completion statement, car lifts inspected every 2 years; 2025 parliamentary debate says regulation requires lift servicing at least 4 times a year, with wheelchair-lift changes under consultation (https://island.is/taeki-og-velbunadur/lyftur-og-rennistigar; https://island.is/taeki-og-velbunadur/katlar-og-thrystibunadur). See candidates C06 and C08.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Drinking-water reg. 536/2001 (last amendment found 570/2018); MAST guidance says smaller supplies need internal monitoring, HACCP only for supplies serving 5,000 or more (https://www.mast.is/static/files/12Leidbeiningar/leidbeiningar-eftirlit-med-neysluvatni-.pdf). Health committees supervise. No 2025 change found; no obvious software gap confirmed.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Only found marketing-authorisation rules at Umhverfisstofnun (113 products authorised, 2015 answer). No applicator logbook or dealer register duty found; thin screening.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Staff-leasing firms must be on a public register and give notice 8 working days before providing services for more than 10 working days in 12 months (Act 139/2005). From 1 Jan 2025 Vinnueftirlit ríkisins took over Vinnumálastofnun's tasks for staff leasing and posted workers (https://island.is/s/vinnumalastofnun/frett/flutningur-a-verkefnum-til-vinnueftirlits-rikisins). See candidate C04.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Funeral service needs a licence under Act 36/1993 and reg. 426/2006; sources conflict on whether sýslumaður or the ministry issues it; no 2025-26 change; Reykjavík cemetery reg. 533/2026 published May 2026 (https://island.is/utfararthjonustuleyfi; https://adverts.stjornartidindi.is/B_nr_533_2026.pdf). Few operators. Weak.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Act 119/2019 public-benefit associations: mandatory register at Ríkisskattstjóri for those that collect or distribute funds with cross-border activity; accounts finalised within 6 months of year end and published within a month of approval; amended by Act 110/2021 (https://www.althingi.is/lagasafn/pdf/157c/2019119.pdf). See candidate C05. Halal/kosher supervision not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Taxi: Act 120/2022 as amended by Act 23/2026 (from 1 June 2026): stations must keep an electronic register incl. taximeter serial numbers and satellite data, payments for fixed-price trips must be recorded, annual independent audit of electronic systems, 60-day data retention (https://adverts.stjornartidindi.is/A_nr_23_2026.pdf; https://island.is/s/samgongustofa/frett/breytingar-a-loegum-um-leigubifreidaakstur-taka-gildi-1-juni). See candidate C01. Minibus, trucking and bus fleet rules not searched; kilometre fee is K01.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Commercial currency exchange must register with FME/Central Bank under Act 140/2018 (regs 670/2018, 151/2023); side-activity exemption for retailers below ISK 5m a year and ISK 100k per customer (https://island.is/v/skrifstofa-fjarmalagreininga-loegreglu/tilkynningarskyldir-adilar). Tiny population. No market-trader rules searched.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo studios need health-committee licence or registration, home tattooing illegal (https://reykjavik.is/en/node/24191). Driving schools licensed by Samgöngustofa (https://island.is/umsokn-um-starfsleyfi-oekuskola). Childminders licensed nationally by the welfare quality agency (GEV) (https://island.is/saekja-um-leyfi-sem-dagforeldri); matches K09. Reindeer hunting guides need Umhverfisstofnun permit, file hunting reports (https://www.umhverfisstofnun.is/library/sida/Veidi/Hreindyr/sidareglur_lei%c3%b0s%c3%b6gumanna.pdf). Home food production: nothing specific found.

candidates.buyer: Bookkeeping and tax-adviser firms, company service providers, precious metal/stone dealers, art dealers and galleries (not law firms, auditors or financial institutions)
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
candidates.evidence: https://www.skatturinn.is/um-rsk/frettir-og-tilkynningar/skraning-vegna-adgerda-gegn-peningathvaetti-og-fjarmognun-hrydjuverka ; https://island.is/s/skatturinn/frett/skraning-vegna-adgerda-gegn-peningathvaetti-og-fjarmognun-hrydjuverka-22-12-2025 ; https://www.skatturinn.is/fagadilar/peningathvaetti/akvardanir-rikisskattstjora/ (Enor ehf. settlement Mar 2026 per search summary)
candidates.existing: Competitor search (Icelandic, AML + bookkeeping + software) found no software or service for this group, only the state portal and the law. A generic AML vendor may exist and was not found.
candidates.name: AML registration, risk assessment and compliance pack for bookkeeping firms, tax advisers and TCSPs
candidates.trigger: Art. 36, law 140/2018: new Skatturinn registration portal opened 22 Dec 2025. Written methodology and risk assessment updated every 2 years (law 62/2022 amending art. 5). Skatturinn publishes settlements and fines.
candidates.unchecked: Registration deadline (not on the pages read); number of registrable firms; whether the group must file FIU reports (goAML) and the annual questionnaire; whether the accounting software vendors or the bookkeepers' association already supply templates; willingness to pay.

candidates.buyer: Real-estate agencies, car/ship/business sellers, property companies supervised by Skatturinn (art. 2(1) l-u of law 140/2018)
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
candidates.existing: Not searched separately; the bookkeeping-AML search found no tool for this buyer either.
candidates.name: AML pack for real-estate agencies, car dealers and property companies
candidates.trigger: Ongoing AML duties (beneficial-owner checks, due diligence). Settlement decision 5/2026 (8 Sept 2026) with Fasteignasala Hákot ehf. over beneficial-owner failures, fine at 50% of the proposed penalty; 2024 decision against Kasa fasteignir ehf.
candidates.unchecked: Number of agencies and dealers; real-estate-system vendors (e.g. Fasteignaleit-type tools) and generic KYC vendors; whether the ownership checks are already covered by the state beneficial-owner register; the competitor search for this score-3 candidate was not run, and neither were rental-agency or car-dealer cases.

candidates.buyer: Licensed electrical contractors (rafverktakar) of all sizes, mostly small firms
candidates.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
candidates.existing: Competitor search (Icelandic, contractor safety system + software) found no software, only regulation texts. HMS offers forms and a sample audit form, and its portal holds completion reports.
candidates.name: Safety management system and job records for licensed electrical contractors
candidates.trigger: Law 146/1996 and reg. 678/2009: contractors must run an HMS safety management system with traceable job records kept at least 4 years, per-job self-reviews and measurements, notifications and completion reports through HMS's central electrical safety portal, and an internal audit at least once a year. Accredited inspection bodies audit the system. HMS can revoke the licence for serious deficiencies.
candidates.unchecked: Number of licensed contractors; whether generic project, field-service or quality-management tools already used by Icelandic electricians cover this; what the inspection bodies accept; HMS portal API; willingness to pay. K07 covers general construction QMS and the building-permit portal, which are a different duty and buyer.

candidates.buyer: Self-employed physiotherapists, specialist doctors and other independent health providers billing Sjúkratryggingar
candidates.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
candidates.existing: None searched. Clinics probably use existing practice-management systems, such as Sögukerfi-type products, and these were not checked.
candidates.name: Annual accounts and billing pack for self-employed health providers under Sjúkratryggingar contracts, with patient-injury insurance registration
candidates.trigger: Patient-injury insurance (law 47/2024) moved to Sjúkratryggingar from 1 Jan 2025, with provider registration in the Gagnagátt portal. A Jan 2026 proposal would require contracted parties to hand over annual accounts, staff numbers and related-party transactions to SÍ, following a National Audit Office recommendation.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the accounts-disclosure proposal became law; the format SÍ will require; the number of providers; what clinic software already exports. The competitor search for this score-3 item was not run (budget).

candidates.buyer: Small tour, activity and travel operators (glacier, whale-watching, horse, super-jeep and similar)
candidates.category: 31. Adventure-tourism and tour operators: safety plans, licences, insurance (Ferðamálastofa)
candidates.existing: Not checked. The safety-plan form is a Ferðamálastofa product.
candidates.name: Safety plan and licence pack for small tour and adventure operators
candidates.trigger: Law 96/2018 (travel services / tourism): a written safety plan (risk assessment, procedures, incident report, response plan) in Icelandic on a Ferðamálastofa form, supervised by Ferðamálastofa; liability insurance wording in the bill history.
candidates.unchecked: The current safety-plan regulation and what Ferðamálastofa requires today; how many operators file; whether the form is free and electronic; who sells safety-plan services (e.g. Safetravel/ICE-SAR-linked); the competitor search was not run.

candidates.buyer: Small importers and domestic producers of packaged goods
candidates.category: 33. Producer-responsibility importers and packers: Úrvinnslusjóður levy (law 162/2002)
candidates.existing: Not checked: importer ERP modules, customs-broker services, and Úrvinnslusjóður's own portal.
candidates.name: Packaging declaration and levy filing for small importers (Úrvinnslugjald)
candidates.trigger: Law 162/2002: all producers and importers pay the levy and must give packaging weight and type. A temporary fallback rule (2024 amendment) for importers lacking packaging data ran until 1 Jan 2026 while a new packaging model (Annex XVIII) was introduced.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the temporary rule was extended or the new model now binds importers; filing frequency and portal; customs integration; number of small importers; the competitor search was not run.

candidates.buyer: Restaurants, cafes, bakeries and small food producers with a municipal starfsleyfi
candidates.category: 36. Food businesses: mandatory internal control (innra eftirlit) and municipal health inspection
candidates.existing: One search found guidance PDFs but no software; apps for temperature logging may exist and were not found.
candidates.name: Food-business internal control (HACCP) records for small food and catering businesses
candidates.trigger: Food Act 93/1995: internal control is a licence condition; inspection frequency is risk-based; fees can be reduced for certified or better-than-required control (Reykjavík health authority).
candidates.unchecked: Vendors of HACCP/temperature-logging apps in Iceland; whether inspectors accept digital records; number of licensed premises. The group-A category 20 worker may cover the same buyer. Competitor search was a generic one, not the targeted one.

candidates.buyer: Small hotels and guest houses with a rekstrarleyfi
candidates.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
candidates.existing: Property-management and channel-manager systems for hotels already exist; none were checked by name.
candidates.name: Licensed accommodation operating-licence and levy compliance (hotels, guest houses)
candidates.trigger: Reg. 1277/2016 (four accommodation categories, operating licence) under the accommodation law 85/2007. A tourist-tax change in 2026 could not be confirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether a gistináttaskattur change or a guest register duty exists in 2026.

candidates.buyer: Fuel sellers (a handful of chains and independents)
candidates.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
candidates.existing: Large chains have their own ERP systems.
candidates.name: Monthly fuel sales, stock and shrinkage report to Orkustofnun
candidates.trigger: Reg. 97/2021 under law 40/2013: report by the 25th of each month; renewable-fuel traceability records; producers report by 1 March.
candidates.unchecked: Number of independent sellers and any small LPG distributors; whether a state portal handles the submission.

candidates.buyer: Staff-leasing firms and the firms that hire from them
candidates.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
candidates.existing: Not checked.
candidates.name: Staff-leasing notification and user-firm verification
candidates.trigger: Act 139/2005: leasing firms notify Vinnumálastofnun; the user firm must obtain written proof of notification before service starts and report refusals. Chain-liability rules were not confirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Registry volume; whether the duty is a one-off form rather than a recurring report; whether construction firms face stricter chain-liability checks.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Monthly sales/stock/shrinkage report to Orkustofnun by the 25th (reg. 97/2021, law 40/2013); fuel quality/GHG reports to Umhverfisstofnun (reg. 960/2016). Sellers are a handful of large chains (N1, Olís, Orkan, Atlantsolía), so weak buyer group. Candidate listed as weak.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: No commodity-trading sector in Iceland. The nearest regulated trade is fish market and reweighing licences, screened under 35.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: No search spent. Iceland has no credit-union sector and only a few legacy kaupfélög; judged low-yield, but unverified.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Self-employed physios, specialist doctors and others bill Sjúkratryggingar (regs 1364/2019, 1255/2018). Patient-injury insurance (law 47/2024) moved to Sjúkratryggingar from 1 Jan 2025 with Gagnagátt registration. A Jan 2026 proposal would require contractors to hand over annual accounts to SÍ; enactment not confirmed. Candidate listed as unverified.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Narcotic/controlled-drug rules in reg. 233/2001, last amendment seen 2024-04-05. Pharmacy sector is consolidated into chains. Nothing new and no candidate.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Act 139/2005: staff-leasing firms must notify Vinnumálastofnun; user firms must obtain written proof of notification and report refusals. Candidate listed as weak. Chain-liability rules not confirmed.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Licensed electrical contractors must run an HMS safety management system, keep records 4 years, run an annual internal audit and report completion in HMS's central electrical safety portal (law 146/1996). No software found. Candidate listed. General construction QMS is K07.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Skatturinn opened a registration portal on 22 Dec 2025 under art. 36 of law 140/2018 for bookkeepers, tax advisers, TCSPs, precious metal/stone dealers and art dealers (law firms, auditors and financial institutions exempt). Risk assessment must be updated every 2 years (law 62/2022). Settlements in 2026 against a real estate agency and Enor ehf. Two candidates listed.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Regulation 1277/2016 sets four accommodation categories plus operating licence and home-accommodation registration; 3,582 homes registered in 2023. Homestay is K06. Could not find a 2026 tourist-tax or guest-register change. Licensed accommodation listed as weak.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Seafood catch certificates are K03 and landing logbooks are K04; nothing new. No search on timber or other commodities.

coverage.category: 31. Adventure-tourism and tour operators: safety plans, licences, insurance (Ferðamálastofa)
coverage.found: Law 96/2018 defines a written safety plan (risk assessment, procedures, incident report, response plan) in Icelandic on a Ferðamálastofa form, with supervision by Ferðamálastofa. Current enforcement, insurance rules and competitors not checked. Candidate listed as unverified.

coverage.category: 32. Taxi drivers and operators (law 120/2022, reg. 324/2023)
coverage.found: Samgöngustofa issues work and operating licences and runs an electronic database. No bookkeeping or per-trip logging duty found. Candidate listed as weak.

coverage.category: 33. Producer-responsibility importers and packers: Úrvinnslusjóður levy (law 162/2002)
coverage.found: Importers and producers must declare packaging weight and type. A temporary fallback rule for importers lacking packaging data expired 1 Jan 2026 (Annex XVIII packaging model). Candidate listed as unverified; 2025-26 changes not confirmed.

coverage.category: 34. River fishing associations and rights holders (law 61/2006)
coverage.found: Duty to report catches per water, with electronic reporting through the research institute since 2011. Associations must keep a dividend register (arðskrá) and management plans confirmed by Fiskistofa. Candidate listed as weak.

coverage.category: 35. Fish weighing licence holders and fish markets (reweighing, home weighing)
coverage.found: 79 reweighing licence holders and 17 home-weighing licence holders in 2024. Fiskistofa monitors ice ratio using electronic data analysis. Candidate listed as weak; K04 is the vessel logbook.

coverage.category: 36. Food businesses: mandatory internal control (innra eftirlit) and municipal health inspection
coverage.found: Internal control is a starfsleyfi condition under Food Act 93/1995; inspection frequency is risk-based, and fee reductions are possible for certified or stronger controls. No software found in one search. Candidate listed as unverified.

coverage.category: 37. Aquaculture (lagareldi bill, Althing 157, case 529; MAST reg. 1152/2025)
coverage.found: A comprehensive aquaculture act is pending (consultation closed 26 Jan 2026), and licensing runs through MAST and Umhverfisstofnun. Operators are few and large, so no real candidate.

candidates.buyer: Private and small water supplies: farms, rural water associations and tourism sites serving 20 or more households or 50 or more residents, or food production. Roughly 797 supplies in total, with several hundred private ones (an old Samorka estimate of 500-1,000, undated).
candidates.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction (adjacent to 13. Small water systems)
candidates.existing: None seen in one competitor-style search. Free MAST guidance exists; the health committees do the inspections.
candidates.name: Compliance pack for small private water supplies (permit, internal control, sampling plan)
candidates.trigger: Water supplies need an operating licence from the local health committee and routine monitoring. MAST guidance exempts only supplies with fewer than 20 households or 50 residents. Drinking water is treated as food, so internal control is required (Reg. 522/1994; its current status is unverified). Samples are checked against Reg. 536/2001, as amended by 570/2018 with a monitoring plan. Treatment such as chemical dosing needs a separate approval.
candidates.unchecked: Current supply count and the share of non-compliant ones. Whether 522/1994 was replaced. Local health committee fee and sampling rules. Willingness to pay (a diffuse rural buyer with low spend). Any vendor, consultancy or lab bundle. Mostly belongs to category 13, so the other worker should check it.

candidates.buyer: Condominium owners' associations (húsfélög) under the Condominium Act 26/1994. They must register with Skatturinn for a kennitala (form RSK 17.02, fee ISK 30,000), report changes (ISK 2,200) and report signing authority (RSK 17.92).
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations (adjacent to 23)
candidates.existing: Not checked. No housing-association software surfaced in one search.
candidates.name: Housing association (húsfélög) admin and registration pack
candidates.trigger: Registration and change notifications to Skatturinn. Whether húsfélög must file annual accounts, and who has to file, was not established.
candidates.unchecked: Annual filing duty, the existing housing-association management software and services, the number of associations, and whether the buyers are property managers rather than owners. Likely a crowded and generic bookkeeping space.

candidates.buyer: Housing co-ops under Act 66/2003 (Búseti hsf. is the visible one)
candidates.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
candidates.existing: Not applicable: the buyer set is too small.
candidates.name: Housing co-operatives (húsnæðissamvinnufélög) reporting
candidates.trigger: Act 66/2003 (co-op law applies as relevant); HMS oversight and reporting duties were not found.
candidates.unchecked: Number of housing co-ops. Probably one or two large bodies with in-house staff, so not a software market.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: No licensing regime for drilling contractors found. Groundwater abstraction needs a utilisation permit from Orkustofnun (now Umhverfis- og orkustofnun) under Art. 6 of Act 57/1998, with Nature Institute and Environment Agency opinions; deep drilling also needs notification to Skipulagsstofnun (Act 111/2021, Annex I item 2.04). Orkustofnun keeps a public borehole register (borholuskrá) naming the driller. Visible permit applicants are large (Rio Tinto, HEF veitur, Landeldis, Stofnfiskur, i.e. fish farms and utilities), which is out of scope. A driller's reporting duty to the register was not confirmed, and no small-driller niche or vendor was seen. Nothing usable beyond the one adjacent lead in the ledger (small private water supplies).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Iceland has no credit-union sector. Savings banks (sparisjóðir) are few and are licensed financial firms under the Central Bank. Ordinary co-ops fall under Act 22/1991 with a co-op register (samvinnufélagaskrá) run by the tax authority (Skatturinn). Accounts go to the annual accounts register, and non-filers for three years can be deregistered; the registrar and the deadline were not confirmed for ordinary co-ops. Housing co-ops (Búseti hsf. under Act 66/2003) are few and large. Co-op count and the sector are tiny, so no standalone candidate. Nothing new beyond one weak related lead (housing associations, húsfélög) in the ledger.
